srd_sneer.evidence: The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or take psychic damage equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

srd_sphere_of_order.evidence: Chaotic creatures that start their turn in the area or enter it on their turn take 5d8 psychic damage.

srd_spinning_axes.evidence: A bleeding creature takes 2d6 necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns for 1 minute.

srd_srd_2024_acid_arrow.evidence: On a hit, the target takes 4d4 Acid damage and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn.

srd_srd_2024_arcane_hand.evidence: On a hit, the target takes 5d8 Force damage.

srd_srd_2024_blink.evidence: Roll 1d6 at the end of each of your turns for the duration.

srd_srd_2024_contact_other_plane.evidence: On a failed save, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the Incapacitated condition until you finish a Long Rest.

srd_srd_2024_control_water.evidence: As a Magic action on your later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

srd_srd_2024_control_weather.evidence: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration.

srd_srd_2024_delayed_blast_fireball.evidence: The spell's base damage is 12d6, and the damage increases by 1d6 whenever your turn ends and the spell hasn't ended.

srd_srd_2024_dream.evidence: On a failed save, the target gains no benefit from its rest, and it takes 3d6 Psychic damage when it wakes up.

srd_srd_2024_enlargereduce.evidence: The target's attacks with its enlarged weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit.

srd_srd_2024_ensnaring_strike.evidence: While Restrained, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

srd_srd_2024_freezing_sphere.evidence: You can refrain from firing the globe after completing the spell's casting.

srd_srd_2024_geas.evidence: While Charmed, the creature takes 5d10 Psychic damage if it acts in a manner directly counter to your command.

srd_srd_2024_glyph_of_warding.evidence: When triggered, the glyph erupts with magical energy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on the glyph.

srd_srd_2024_mirror_image.evidence: Each time a creature hits you with an attack roll during the spell's duration, roll a d6 for each of your remaining duplicates.

srd_srd_2024_phantasmal_force.evidence: On each of your turns, such a phantasm can deal 2d8 Psychic damage to the target if it is in the phantasm's area or within 5 feet of the phantasm.

srd_srd_2024_prismatic_spray.evidence: For each target, roll 1d8 to determine which color ray affects it, consulting the Prismatic Rays table.

srd_srd_2024_prismatic_wall.evidence: Each layer forces the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw or be affected by that layer's properties as described in the Prismatic Layers table.

srd_srd_2024_reincarnate.evidence: Roll 1d10 and consult the table below to determine the body's species, or the GM chooses another playable species.

srd_srd_2024_searing_smite.evidence: At the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, the target takes 1d6 Fire damage and then makes a Constitution saving throw.

srd_srd_2024_storm_of_vengeance.evidence: At the start of each of your later turns, the storm produces different effects, as detailed below.

srd_srd_2024_symbol.evidence: Each creature in the Sphere when the glyph activates is targeted by its effect, as is a creature that enters the Sphere for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

srd_srd_2024_teleport.evidence: The GM rolls 1d100 and consults the Teleportation Outcome table and the explanations after it.

srd_srd_2024_time_stop.evidence: No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.

srd_srd_2024_weird.evidence: On a failed save, it takes 5d10 Psychic damage.

srd_srd_2024_wish.evidence: The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of level 8 or lower.

srd_srd_blink.evidence: Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell.

srd_srd_color_spray.evidence: Roll 6d10; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can effect.

srd_srd_confusion.evidence: An affected target can't take reactions and must roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn.

srd_srd_contact_other_plane.evidence: On a failure, you take 6d6 psychic damage and are insane until you finish a long rest.

srd_srd_control_weather.evidence: It takes 1d4 x 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect.

srd_srd_delayed_blast_fireball.evidence: If at the end of your turn the bead has not yet detonated, the damage increases by 1d6.

srd_srd_enhance_ability.evidence: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement.

srd_srd_enlargereduce.evidence: While these weapons are enlarged, the target's attacks with them deal 1d4 extra damage.

srd_srd_faithful_hound.evidence: At the start of each of your turns, the hound attempts to bite one creature within 5 feet of it that is hostile to you.

srd_srd_false_life.evidence: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.

srd_srd_fire_shield.evidence: The attacker then suffers 2d8 points of fire damage or cold, depending on the model.

srd_srd_geas.evidence: While the creature is charmed by you, it takes 5d10 psychic damage each time it acts in a manner directly counter to your instructions, but no more than once each day.

srd_srd_guardian_of_faith.evidence: The creature takes 20 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

srd_srd_heroes_feast.evidence: Its hit point maximum also increases by 2d10, and it gains the same number of hit points.

srd_srd_slow.evidence: Each target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration.

srd_srd_spiritual_weapon.evidence: As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

srd_srd_time_stop.evidence: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself.

srd_srd_web.evidence: Any 5-foot cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 round, dealing 2d4 fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire.

srd_storm_of_wings.evidence: Each creature in the storm when it appears and each a creature that starts its turn in the storm is affected by the storm.

srd_sudden_stampede.evidence: Each creature in the line takes 6d10 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.

srd_summon_eldritch_servitor.evidence: You summon eldritch aberrations that appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within range.

srd_surprise_blessing.evidence: You touch a willing creature and choose one of the conditions listed below that the creature is currently subjected to.

srd_talons_of_a_hungry_land.evidence: When the lines appear, each creature in their area must make a Dexterity saving throw.
